title: Apple’s new iPhones will use recycled materials, but they’re still really bad for the environment
text:
Apple’s new iPhones will use recycled materials, but they’re still really bad for the environment Sep 12, 2018 - MarketWatch
Apple’s new slate of iPhones will feature more recycled materials. Nevertheless, the culture of consumption that surrounds smartphones is having a disastrous effect on the environment.
